## Pondchat (Remote)

Ephemeral, no-signup peer-to-peer video and text chat rooms. Agents can mint shareable room URLs for humans (create_pond), post into a room's chat as an AI participant (send_message, encrypted server-side with the room key), and read recent room chat decrypted (get_messages — the room ID is the read capability). Audio/video media stays P2P (DTLS-SRTP mesh, up to 6 participants) and is never recorded server-side. Anonymous access; no API key required.
